newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria sees extra few bln ATS from CA merger.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria sees extra few bln ATS from CA merger.

text.p: Bank Austria which won the bid for flagship bank Creditanstalt said on Sunday the merger would bring in "several billion schillings" in extra revenue.
"Based on conservative estimates the future results of the Bank Austria-CA group should bring in extra earnings potential of several billion schillings," a statement from the bank said.
Austria's biggest bank added it would finance the takeover from its own funds.
The link-up of Austria's two top banks will create a financial powerhouse with some 1,300 billion schillings, employing more than 16,000 people, the bank said.
The takeover would lead to a new Europe-oriented order of Austria's banking sector, it added. Bank Austria guaranteed its headquarters would remain in Austria.
The bank said a planned restructuring of the merged banks would make the bank more competitive worldwide and help to strengthen project and export financing, as well as bringing in more risk capital.
The bank would further benefit in the areas of electronic banking, investment banking and asset management, Bank Austria said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
